newsitem.title: USA: National Patent says to buy back stock.
newsitem.headline: National Patent says to buy back stock.

text.p: National Patent Development Corp said Friday its board has authorized it to buy back about 750,000 shares, or about seven percent of its common shares outstanding.
The company said its shares are selling at a discount to book value, which exceeded $11.00 per share at March 31.
The company said the buy back program will benefit its shareholders by increasing the bookvalue of their holdings.
The company said its acquisition of the remaining 48 percent of General Physics Corp strengthens its financial position, and allows it to buy back the shares.
The company said it will buy back to stock from time to time in open market transactions.
